SECTION_DIVIDER entries occupy order slots in these lists. Strip them before counting questions: Housekeeping 27 rows = 22 questions + 5 dividers; Maintenance 16 = 13 + 3; Room Inspection 30 = 26 + 4; Pressure Washing 10 = 8 + 2; Roof PM 10 = 8 + 2; Property Inspection 12 = 12 + 0.

NOT EXHAUSTIVELY VERIFIED: the Room Inspection sheet holds 2,773 attachments across 28 pages. I enumerated page 1 (newest, Aug 2026) and page 28 (oldest, Dec 2025) in full and ran targeted global searches for every candidate template name. Pages 2–27 were not enumerated, so a template appearing only in the middle of that range could have been missed. The targeted searches make that unlikely but not impossible.

Filename dates are unreliable as submission dates. Some Roof PM and Pressure Washing filenames use DD_MM_YYYY (e.g. '18_11_2025') while the app-generated portion uses MM_DD_YYYY. The in-PDF timestamp line is the trustworthy source and is what I recorded in the 'date' fields where they conflict.
